title: Incandescent Staff

sources.title: Fire Bolt
markers: | description = Hurl a mote of fire.

sources.title: Fireball
markers: | description = Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity for {{DamageText|8d6|Fire}} damage.

summary: A quarterstaff that gives +1 to ranged spell attack rolls and Fire resistance, and grants Fire Bolt and Fireball.

fields.Fire Bolt: Action. Ranged spell attack out to 60 ft. On hit deal 1d10 Fire, increasing to 2d10 at character level 5 and 3d10 at level 10.
fields.Fireball: Action once per Long Rest. Target a point within 60 ft. Creatures in a 13 ft-radius burst take 8d6 Fire, or half on a successful Dexterity save against your spell save DC.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Quartermaster Talli at Last Light Inn.
fields.Base value: 770 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
